output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: Rosa's kitchen clock runs 15 minutes fast, so the piano ran from 22:33 to 22:46 true time. Girard's watch runs 4 minutes slow, and it gives the same times. Madame was at the piano for that whole span, so she was in the salon. The piano began when the doctor left the room, so he was out of the salon from 22:33 to 22:46. Félix's watch runs 20 minutes slow. His thump at 22:18 by his watch is 22:38 true. Girard's faint repeater bells at 22:34 by his watch are also 22:38 true. Both were heard while the piano was playing, so the repeater sounded at 22:38. Félix also heard someone go up the stairs at about 22:35 and come down at about 22:41. Only the doctor was free and unaccounted for then. Madame was playing, Lina and Rosa were together in the kitchen, Girard was in the street, and Félix was in the library. The doctor lied when he said he left at a quarter to eleven by his watch, which is about 22:43 true. That would have put his absence after the blow. Lina said the regulator showed 22:20 and was running, and it agreed with the bell at ten. It was therefore accurate, so the hands set to 22:05 were set by the murderer to fake a stopped time. The murderer's lie is the doctor's false departure time.
